title: Bull
description:
S01 E10 — E.J.
Bull tries to help a CEO whose company is accused of killing an employee with its self-driving car, but a secret emerges that could sabotage a trial win.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E11 — Teacher's Pet
An attorney for one of Bull's former clients asks him to consult on a couple's civil suit against a teacher who had a sexual relationship with their son; the trial strategy suffers a major setback when the teen switches to the teacher's side.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E12 — Stockholm Syndrome
The wife of a man whom Danny helped imprison for manslaughter detonates a bomb at the TAC offices and takes the team hostage to force Bull to prove her husband's innocence.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E24 — Pa'a Ka 'Ipuka i Ka 'Upena Nananana
Five-0 tries to protect a wounded Gabriel and plan an escape when enemy gunmen storm the dilapidated building in which Gabriel is trapped.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E25 — O Ke Ali'I Wale No Ka'u Makemake
McGarrett and Danny pose as drug pilots in a plan to stop a meth epidemic on the island; Danny is forced to break cover and land the plane when McGarrett is seriously wounded.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E01 — Makaukau 'oe e Pa'ani?
The team hunts for a murderer who has been targeting serial killers, marking their corpses with an ivory chess piece.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E02 — No Ke Ali'i Wahine A Me Ka Aina
A rogue MI-6 agent is the key to finding a terrorist who plans to cause the meltdown of nuclear reactors across Europe; McGarrett and Danny need the help of an FBI profiler to find a killer.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E03 — He Moho Hou
After finding a corpse in her bed, FBI profiler Alicia Brown joins McGarrett in a hunt for a killer; Kono reconnects with a former surfing competitor.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E04 — Hu A'e Ke Ahi Lanakila A Kamaile
When the serial killer that Alicia and McGarrett have been hunting kidnaps them, it's up to Five-0 to find them before it's too late.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E05 — Ke Ku 'Ana
A cache of guns is stolen by a person looking to make a statement on gun violence; Kono and Adam are reunited.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E06 — Ka Hale Ho' Okauweli
On Halloween, the team investigates the murder of a medium who was apparently frightened to death by a poltergeist; a mysterious death cult kidnaps Kono and Adam.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E07 — Ka Makuahine A Me Ke Keikikane
Catherine informs Five-0 that McGarrett's mother has been captured and is in danger of being executed for trying to free Wo Fat's imprisoned father; Chin is unable to delay Sara's adoption.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E08 — Hana Komo Pae
While Danny chaperones Grace's high school dance, the venue is seized by terrorists, who hold everyone hostage with the intent of abducting a diplomat's son; Danny and Grover discover that Will is Grace's secret boyfriend.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E09 — Elua La Ma Nowemapa
A conspiracy theorist with compelling information that JFK's own cabinet planned his assassination is murdered.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E10 — Ka Luhi
A boy suffering from PTSD undergoes hypnosis and realizes he may have witnessed a murder related to a 10-year-old cold case; Danny's sister visits Oahu.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E11 — Ka'ili Aku
The team rushes to Mexico, where Chin puts his life in jeopardy in an effort to rescue Sara, his kidnapped niece.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E12 — Ka 'aelike
When Chin is kidnapped by a Mexican cartel, Five-0 must rescue him before he is executed by the vengeful group; Grover goes undercover to investigate a murder, which turns out to be far more complex and dangerous than anticipated.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S04 E09 — Hau'oli La Ho'omaika'i
A Secret Service agent is murdered while the president is traveling to Oahu; as Thanksgiving approaches, McGarrett's Aunt Deb (Carol Burnett) visits and shares a stunning secret.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E08 — Lele Pu Na Manu Like
Grover's parents and brother arrive in Oahu for Thanksgiving; a thief is crushed to death by an empty safe.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E09 — Ka la'au kumu 'ole o Kahilikolo
Junior and Tani track down the thief who robbed his parents' home; Five-0 investigates the murder of a beloved philanthropist and the theft of his valuable koa tree; Danny moves in with McGarrett.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E13 — Ho'i mau na 'opua i Awalua
While Max prepares to say his goodbyes, the team investigates a murder during a police convention on the island.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E14 — Ka Laina Ma Ke One
The team faces a contentious U.S. Marshall after a murder suspect escapes capture and looks for asylum in the sovereign land that belongs to the Nation of Hawaii.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E15 — Ka Pa'ani Nui
While working a murder case, Five-0 discovers that a former Nazi war criminal may be hiding out in an old leprosy colony in Hawaii.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E15 — Incel
The team must track down a murderous member of the incel community targeting those he believes never give him a chance; Barnes, Hana, Ortiz and Kristin deal with their grief in the wake of Jess' death.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E02 — Red Cell + Quantum + Cold + Committed
Gen. John Acosta recruits MacGyver to steal a highly classified project from a military lab to find flaws in its security.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E03 — Kid + Plane + Cable + Truck
MacGyver and the team are on a plane that's in the air when the pilot has a heart attack.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E04 — Windmill + Acetone + Celluloid + Firing Pin
As MacGyver works quickly to rescue survivors from a collapsed building in Germany, he discovers a new safety threat -- an undetonated bomb from World War II is hidden beneath the rubble.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E05 — Soccer + Desi + Merchant + Titan
In an attempt to find the main players in the Codex and cut off their match-fixing funding, Desi goes undercover to infiltrate a soccer team and find the corrupt player working with the shadow organization.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E06 — Right + Wrong + Both + Neither
When Russ' first love, Emilia, is kidnapped by the same rebels he fought during his private military contract days, he takes the Phoenix team to a small, impoverished town to rescue her and rid the town of the rebels for good.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E07 — Mac + Desi + Riley + Aubrey
A double date descends into chaos when Mac and Desi witness a murder in the back of the restaurant; as they work to find the killer, Riley tries to keep the secret about her and her friends' "day jobs" from her new boyfriend.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E08 — Father + Son + Father + Matriarch
After Oversight is almost killed in a bombing, he recruits Mac to help him find the suspected bomber; Mac meets his Aunt Gwendolyn.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E05 — The Tall Man
The BAU investigates a spooky local ghost story of the "Tall Man" and the clues it provides when two people go missing in the woods; a third person mysteriously surfaces the following day with limited details as to what happened to her friends.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E06 — Luke
The BAU investigates four murders along the eastern seaboard; the crimes become personal for Alvez when the team discovers there are ties to his time spent in pursuit of a notorious hit man; Alvez and his girlfriend decide to move in together.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E07 — Twenty Seven
The BAU races to capture the vigilantes behind a series of attacks taking place every 27 minutes in the nation's capital; Prentiss and Unit Chief Andrew Mendoza lead the effort to identify the vigilantes and what's motivating them.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E08 — Ashley
The BAU investigates a double homicide and kidnapping in New Hampshire; Rossi's plans to elevate his relationship with Krystall don't go as planned.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E09 — Broken Wing
A professor from Lewis' past tips off the BAU to an alarming number of overdose deaths of patients who just completed rehab.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E10 — Flesh and Blood
Prentiss faces her past when the BAU is sent to investigate the murders of prominent businessmen, all of whom are missing their hearts; Prentiss plans a romantic first date with Mendoza, but the evening is cut short by an urgent call from Rossi.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E11 — Night Lights
The BAU team heads to Portland, Ore., to investigate a chilling abduction that may be linked to a local couple who were killed in their home a week earlier.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E12 — Hamelin
The BAU team flies to Iowa to investigate the disappearance of three 10-year-old children who appear to have been abducted from their homes, with surveillance video from a park as their only lead to finding the children's whereabouts.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E13 — Chameleon
Rossi questions his actions in the aftermath of a struggle with a serial killer who appears to have outsmarted the BAU.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E14 — Sick and Evil
The BAU investigates a string of murders taking place in supposedly haunted houses in Lewiston, Maine.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E15 — Truth or Dare
Rossi prepares to marry Krystall; the team investigates a series of fatal shootings following car accidents.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E01 — Under the Skin
The BAU team investigates an unsub with striking similarities to Rossi's latest obsession, "The Chameleon."

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E02 — Awakenings
The team searches for Everett Lynch and his daughter; Spencer has a meaningful visit with his mother.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E03 — Spectator Slowing
The BAU team investigates a series of seemingly random fatal explosions throughout Kentucky and Tennessee.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E04 — Saturday
The members of the BAU enjoy a Saturday off in vastly different ways; Rossi and Prentiss help Simmons assemble a new crib; Garcia leads a hacking competition; Dr. Reid strikes up a conversation with a woman named Maxine.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E05 — Ghost
Following a series of fatal shootings, the BAU team travels to Illinois to investigate what appears to be a copycat serial killer.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E16 — Decriminalized
The team gets called to Vermont after a married couple who grow illegal marijuana massacre their employees; Barnes begins to regret not taking any time off to bond with her new baby.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E08 — The Illustrated Woman
Toby's investigation into the murder of a tattooed woman leads him to believe that corporate espionage and blackmail are behind the killing.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E09 — Love's a Bitch
The murder of a British spy may be linked to an adulterous dating site.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E10 — The Long Con
Toby and Michelle team up with a con artist to catch a human trafficker.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E17 — Parental Guidance
Bull and the TAC team represent a teenage boy raised in complete isolation who goes on trial for murder after engaging in a shootout.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E18 — Don't Say a Word
Bull's romantic rival, Diana Lindsay, jeopardizes her career when she secretly has Bull come to Texas to assist a couple fighting against her former client for custody of their grandchildren.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E19 — Bounty
Danny enlists Bull's help for the assault trial of her former FBI mentor, a bounty hunter who kidnapped the wrong mark during his first assignment.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E20 — The Good One
Bull fears his client's family ties will negatively impact the jury when he represents the young heir of an infamous crime family; Bull aims to convince his client to sever his trial from his brother's, which would pit them against each other.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E21 — When the Rains Came
Bull helps mount a defense for Taylor's brother-in-law, a prison guard charged with manslaughter for the drowning deaths of two inmates in the middle of a hurricane; Bull aims to convince the jury that his client tried to prevent a "greater harm."

title: Bull
description:
S03 E22 — Pillar of Salt
Bull must convince a jury that an alleged murder was actually a tragic accident when TAC represents a woman charged in her 3-year-old stepdaughter's death; Benny gives Bull some surprising news.

title: Bull
description:
S04 E01 — Labor Days
As Bull prepares for fatherhood, his work at TAC suffers without his top attorney Benny, who quit in reaction to Bull's romantic reconnection to Isabella; the team must mount a defense for a young bartender on trial for involuntary manslaughter.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E21 — Mayhem on a Cross
Booth and Brennan look for a killer and a motive when it is discovered that a human skeleton is being used as a prop for a death metal band.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E22 — The Double Death of the Dearly Departed
Brennan is suspicious when a Jeffersonian co-worker dies of heart failure; Cam tries to get her newly adopted teenager to stop smoking.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E23 — The Girl in the Mask
A friend of Booth's, Ken Nakamura, asks for help when his sister goes missing in Washington.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E24 — The Beaver in the Otter
The body of a fraternity brother is discovered inside a rival school's mascot uniform; Booth tries to help his brother find a new job.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E25 — The Critic in the Cabernet
Brennan asks Booth to be the father of her child; Stewie Griffin (Seth MacFarlane) offers the couple advice.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E26 — The End in the Beginning
When a body is discovered at a popular nightclub, everyone is a suspect.

title: Bones
description:
S05 E01 — Harbingers in the Fountain
Angela's psychic, Avalon Harmonia (Cyndi Lauper), alerts Brennan and Booth to the presence of a mass grave beneath a fountain.

title: Bones
description:
S05 E02 — The Bond in the Boot
Booth and Brennan investigate when a man is murdered for the undisclosed contents of his briefcase; the team looks for alternate funding for Wendell when he loses his scholarship.

title: Bones
description:
S05 E03 — The Plain in the Prodigy
Human remains are found next to a railroad; Cam deals with the stress of being a new parent; Booth tries to keep Cam's stepdaughter in line.

title: Bones
description:
S05 E04 — The Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood
When human remains are found at a neighborhood block party, scandals and suburban politics give many people a motive; Booth's son tries to find a girlfriend for his father.

title: Bones
description:
S05 E05 — A Night at the Bones Museum
Brennan and Booth investigate what appear to be charred human remains on an electrical fence; Brennan goes on a date with Booth's supervisor; Sweets' girlfriend returns to the Jeffersonian.

title: Bones
description:
S05 E06 — The Tough Man in the Tender Chicken
The Jeffersonian team investigates when the mutilated remains of a chicken farmer are found near a river; the case prompts Angela to launch an animal-rights campaign.

title: Bones
description:
S05 E07 — The Dwarf in the Dirt
Booth must be recertified for FBI marksmanship, but he is not the accurate shot he was before having brain surgery; Brennan and Booth investigate the death of a little person who was a wrestler.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E17 — Covenant
Charming but formidable Supervisory Special Agent Remy Scott arrives to lead the team as they investigate a series of homicides tied to a forbidden love between a young teen and her older boyfriend.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E11 — The Jackal Job
The team picks the brain of a legendary grifter and tries to find the loot from her best con before her abusive guardian does.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E12 — The Golf Job
An old friend visits, sparking a self-doubting Harry to uncover an unlikely client on the links at his exclusive golf club.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E13 — The Hurricane Job
Stuck together during a massive hurricane, Eliot and Parker must stop a band of corrupt cops who have taken over a small hotel, and find what the cops are searching for.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E22 — Red Light
Morgan brings the BAU new information in the case against Mr. Scratch, a serial killer and escaped convict who has been wreaking havoc on the team.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E01 — Wheels Up
Agent Matt Simmons joins the BAU team in a race to take down Mr. Scratch and save one of their own in the process.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E02 — To a Better Place
The BAU investigates three similar crimes in which victims' remains are discovered in old suitcases.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E03 — Blue Angel
When an anger-driven, unknown subject targets successful businessmen in Detroit, the BAU must investigate.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E04 — Killer App
The BAU investigates a workplace shooting committed by a state-of-the-art drone in Silicon Valley.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E05 — Lucky Strikes
Morgan returns to the BAU to help Penelope deal with a case that has affected her emotionally.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E06 — The Bunker
The BAU must find out what several missing women have in common to find them.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E07 — Dust and Bones
The BAU searches for a subject who is targeting prominent members of the community.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E08 — Neon Terror
The BAU is called in to investigate when a criminal sensationalizes his crimes by giving the local media exclusive footage.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E09 — False Flag
The BAU is called to investigate when two members of a conspiracy group in Roswell, N.M., perish in quick succession.
